newsitem.title: UK: Radio Chelsea to broadcast the Blues.
newsitem.headline: Radio Chelsea to broadcast the Blues.

text.p: English premier league Chelsea are launching a radio station devoted to covering the team's matches, the soccer club said on Thursday.
"Radio Chelsea' will be run by Planet 24 Radio, pop star Bob Geldof's production company and is scheduled to go on air on February 22, when Chelsea host champions Manchester United.
It will broadcast on the medium wave for some 16 hours on matchdays but will only be audible within a maximum three-mile radius of the Stamford Bridge stadium in west London.
The Radio Authority said Radio Chelsea had been granted a special licence to broadcast 28 times a year. The station is expected to carry advertising.
A number of northern clubs including Manchester United already operate their own radio stations but this is the first time a big London team has experimented with the idea.
